reason: The paper studies RLVR training dynamics and uses trainable activation-space vectors to analyze/recover low-dimensional steering directions. Its procedures compare RL-training updates, frozen-base activations, and gradient interventions; it does not propose or evaluate LLM serving, inference compute reduction, latency, throughput, or memory savings. The lineage link does not match this training-analysis contribution.
title: Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors
